facts.fact: Christian把Sundancer房车开进了北达科他州Williston的Love's加油站——离出发地Browning已有八小时车程，憋着尿的Nate终于盼到停车。
facts.anchor: Christian eased them into the Love’s in Williston, North Dakota—eight hours from Browning.

facts.fact: Nate在Love's厕所的小便池前正要尿出来时，一个戴草帽的牛仔老人走进来在两个尿池外轻松解手，Nate紧张得完全尿不出来，最后又一次败给了公共厕所。
facts.anchor: an old man in a straw cowboy hat moseyed in two slots down, whipped it out and splashed down easy as anything, like he didn’t even have to think about it.

facts.fact: Nate所知的Mooch家事：她两个最年长的儿子在同一年内相继死去，不久后丈夫吸毒过量身亡，最后的小儿子也死于那场她用Sundancer房车来纪念的越野摩托事故。
facts.anchor: The main thing Nate knew of her was that her two oldest sons had died in the same year, like dominoes falling over backwards, then her husband had overdosed not long after, and then her last son had kicked as well in the dirt bike accident she had memorialized with the Sundancer.

facts.fact: Mooch儿子死亡的录像传回Browning后，她据说因悲恸头发瞬间变白；但几个月后Nate在Great Falls的一家一元店里看见她在清空货架上的染发剂。
facts.anchor: But then, a few months after that, he’d seen her at a dollar store down in Great Falls, clearing off a shelf of hair dye.

facts.fact: Christian当卡车司机之前曾从南方一所著名的教会学校被开除，之后开了十五年卡车，还被其他卡车司机打成重伤。
facts.anchor: Nate half remembered that, before Christian became a trucker for fifteen years and ended up getting beat up bad by some other truckers, he’d been kicked out of the church-school he’d famously gotten into down south.

facts.fact: 上路后Christian一直放着Jack Gladstone的卡带，护士Seine带头大声跟着唱，Mooch和连Christian也跟着唱起来；借着歌声掩护，Nate终于在车内厕所里尿了出来。
facts.anchor: He peed almost the whole way through the next song, deflating on his feet, all three of them out there singing with their whole lungs—since Christian had played the cassette all the way out of Montana, they’d learned the songs whether they wanted to or not.

facts.fact: Nate在车里的电视上看见Sebby完完整整、活生生地站在Benjamin Heavy Runner的小屋门口。
facts.anchor: It was Sebby, whole and alive, at the door of Benjamin Heavy Runner’s cabin.

facts.fact: Nate伸出指尖去碰屏幕，指尖与屏幕之间跳出一颗蓝色小火花，随着一声爆响把TV/VCR短路烧坏，塑料外壳里冒出一缕电烟。
facts.anchor: It was enough to arc a tiny blue spark between his finger and the screen, shorting the TV/VCR out with a pop followed by a slower fizzle, a wisp of electrical smoke rising from the plastic casing where the cord ducked in.
